scripts.build:assets: pnpm --dir ../../console build && rm -rf public && cp -R ../../console/dist public
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:assets

GPROXY_LIBSQL_URL.description: Required https:// URL of the libSQL (Turso) database, for example https://your-db-org.turso.io. libsql:// is rejected on edge.

GPROXY_LIBSQL_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Required auth token for the GPROXY_LIBSQL_URL database. Stored as a Worker secret.
